KISS-SIGNER PRACTICE

Practice signing

Try a few signatures on your KISS in a minute, with no coordinator and no real bitcoin. Hold this page on a second screen and point the KISS camera at it.

Only on a KISS with no wallet on it yet, like one you just built. Loading the practice seed replaces the wallet on the device.

The practice seed is public. Anyone can spend what is sent to it. Never send bitcoin to it.

Load the practice seed

On SET UP THIS SIGNER, choose RESTORE SEED WORDS, then SCAN A QR and scan this code, or TYPE MY SEED WORDS and type the 12 words below.

  1. abandon
  2. abandon
  3. abandon
  4. abandon
  5. abandon
  6. abandon
  7. abandon
  8. abandon
  9. abandon
  10. abandon
  11. abandon
  12. about

Switch to testnet

On the home screen tap Settings, then SIGNER, and change NETWORK to TESTNET. These practice payments are testnet ones.

Scan a payment

On the home screen tap Sign, then SCAN QR and OPEN CAMERA, and point it at one of the codes below. Each code is a short loop of frames; hold steady until KISS has them all.

1. A normal payment

KISS shows 60 000 sats going out and a fee of 1 000 sats.

Slide to sign. KISS then shows the signed transaction as a QR. There is nothing to scan it into, and that is fine: it was never real.

2. A payment with a warning

KISS shows 8 000 sats going out and a fee of 10 000 sats.

KISS warns that the fee is high. Read the warning and accept it before the slide will move. This is how KISS asks you to look twice.

3. A payment KISS refuses

KISS says wrong network: mainnet transaction.

This one is for real bitcoin, not testnet, so KISS stops and signs nothing. A refusal always says why.

Every code on this page is made by the KISS Signer source itself, and every amount and answer above is what its own signing code says about that payment. Back to KISS Signer
